send_sol.title: Send SOL between wallets
send_sol.explanation: Transfers SOL from one keypair to another on Solana devnet using SystemProgram.transfer, then confirms the transaction. Amounts are always expressed in lamports (1 SOL = 1_000_000_000 lamports).

send_spl_token.title: Transfer an SPL token
send_spl_token.explanation: Transfers SPL tokens between two associated token accounts for the same mint using the transfer helper from @solana/spl-token. The amount is in token base units, accounting for the mint's decimals.

create_token_account.title: Create an associated token account
create_token_account.explanation: Derives the canonical Associated Token Account (ATA) address for a (mint, owner) pair and creates it on chain if it does not exist, using getOrCreateAssociatedTokenAccount from @solana/spl-token.

derive_pda.title: Derive a program-derived address
derive_pda.explanation: Derives a Program Derived Address deterministically from seeds and a program id using findProgramAddressSync. A PDA lies off the ed25519 curve, so no private key exists; the returned bump seed is what pushes it off the curve. This is a pure client-side computation.

read_account_data.title: Read and deserialize account data
read_account_data.explanation: Fetches raw account info with getAccountInfo (owner program, lamports, data buffer) and deserializes an SPL token account with the typed getAccount helper from @solana/spl-token.
